title: BIL Implementability
lede: Whether the Blazing Imaging Library can be built as specified, where it is likely to go wrong, and what to try first.
control: Tier 1 reading: NITF, GeoTIFF, JPEG 2000, Source, cache, warnings, C++
footer: BIL Implementability, version 13, an assessment of the Blazing Imaging Library (BIL) specification, first made against version 56 and brought in step with version 82, with what has been built, as of 17 October 2026.
